source_text: After the experimental hut trial a sub-sample of 80 An. arabiensis, that were collected alive from the hut with alpha ITN, were tested for the presence of L1014F and L10145S kdr variants. No kdr mutations were detected, confirming earlier reports of metabolic resistance mechanisms [26].
